name: Ruler
source:
One of the 16 playable servants in Fate/Extella.

[spoiler]Her true identity is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War. Her Noble Phantasms are Luminosite Eternelle and La Pucelle.[/spoiler]
translation:
One of the 16 playable servants in Fate/Extella.

[spoiler]Her true identity is Jeanne d'Arc, the Saint of Orleans. A Catholic saint born in Domrémy, France, and the heroine of France who liberated Orléans in the Hundred Years' War. Her Noble Phantasms are Luminosite Eternelle and La Pucelle.[/spoiler]
